business_summary: China Properties Investment Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the money lending and property investment businesses in the People's Republic of China and Hong Kong. The company also provides agency and property development services, as well as financial services. The company was formerly known as Northern International Holdings Ltd. and changed its name to China Properties Investment Holdings Limited in November 2007. China Properties Investment Holdings Limited was incorporated in 1992 and is headquartered in Wan Chai, Hong Kong.
business_summary_ko: 투자 지주 회사인 China Properties Investment Holdings Limited는 중화인민공화국과 홍콩에서 자금 대출 및 부동산 투자 사업에 종사하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 또한 금융 서비스뿐만 아니라 대행사 및 부동산 개발 서비스도 제공합니다. 이 회사는 이전에 Northern International Holdings Ltd.로 알려졌으며 2007년 11월에 China Properties Investment Holdings Limited로 이름을 변경했습니다. China Properties Investment Holdings Limited는 1992년에 설립되었으며 홍콩 완차이에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
